newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Trinecke, Slovak VSZ sign share deal-CTK.
newsitem.headline: Czech Trinecke, Slovak VSZ sign share deal-CTK.

text.p: Czech steel maker Trinecke Zelezarny a.s. signed a contract with the Slovak steelmill VSZ a.s. allowing the firms to eventually buy each other's shares, the local CTK news agency said on Wednesday.
Under the deal, VSZ could buy up to 20 percent stake in Trinecke, which could take 10 percent in VSZ, CTK said.

It added that the agreement, signed at an engineering fair in the second Czech city of Brno, also called for both companies to open negotiations with Poland's Huta Katowice on integration of the steel companies in central Europe.
Further details were immediately available, and company officials were not available for additional comment.
